title: dev/check_whitespace_only.py: --base-revision is required and must name a ref present in the local clone
answers: How do I run the whitespace-only check on my branch locally?
Why does dev/check_whitespace_only.py fail with a git error when I run it?
What value should I pass for the base revision of the whitespace check?
Where is the base revision for the PR whitespace check parsed?
body:
Path: dev/check_whitespace_only.py:parse_args, the command-line entry point for the whitespace-only PR check; it reads --repo owner/name, --pr number and the required --base-revision, then passes the base to get_pr_diff.
Rule: Pass a base ref that exists in your clone, such as upstream/master after fetching it, or HEAD^1 on a CI merge checkout. The script runs `git diff <base>...HEAD`, so HEAD must be the PR head you want to check.
Constraints: The base ref must be fetched first; the script does not fetch it. Without --base-revision, argparse rejects the call. Labels are still looked up through the GitHub API using --repo and --pr only when whitespace-only changes are found.
applies: Developers or agents running dev/check_whitespace_only.py by hand or changing how its base revision is chosen.
says: The pull request whitespace check fails when running locally without a base comparison branch.
How can I run the pull request whitespace verification against my local target branch?
Running the pull request formatting inspection locally fails because the comparison reference was not fetched.
The whitespace validation tool errors immediately because the base revision parameter was omitted.
Make the automated pull request whitespace audit accept existing local branch references during review.
search: `dev/check_whitespace_only.py:parse_args` requires `--base-revision` specifying an already-fetched local ref (such as `upstream/master` or CI `HEAD^1`) for `dev/check_whitespace_only.py:get_pr_diff` to execute `git diff <base>...HEAD`. The script does not fetch the base reference, and omitting `--base-revision` causes `argparse` to reject the invocation. GitHub API label lookups occur via `--repo` and `--pr` only if whitespace-only changes are detected. Guidance applies to developers or agents executing `dev/check_whitespace_only.py` manually or modifying base revision selection.
